topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen and Damage Recognition by Pattern Recognition Receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the innate immune system detects molecular patterns of infection and cellular damage using pattern recognition receptors, toll-like receptors, and the inflammasome.

topics.label: Sentinel Cell Signaling, Leukocyte Recruitment, and Inflammatory Escalation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how activated sentinel cells direct leukocyte recruitment into tissues, drain antigens via lymphatics, and trigger systemic inflammatory responses.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Inflammatory States
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the mechanisms that shut down inflammation, rebuild damaged tissue, and establish chronic inflammatory responses such as granulomas.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation and announces the upcoming topic.
